title: John Kazimer's band personnel
summary: Names who played with Kazimer: Wooden Joe, Carnish, Bob Lyons, bassist Joe Gabriel; discusses Gabriel relations.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You might go into detail a little bit more about some of those bands. Like when you played with John Kazimer, who else was in the band?
Well, during that time they had a fella I know by the name of Wooden Joe. Oh yeah, sure.
And they had Carnish on the trombone. Oh yeah. And uh, every now and then I would see Bob Lyons with him, but Joe Gabriel would play mostly with him at the time, during that time.
I see Joe Gabriel played bass.
Yeah. We talked to Clarence, wasn't it Gabriel? That's Clarence Gabriel. Is there any kid that Clarence is in place in there?
No, I don't think so. No relation to that family?

No, I don't think so because I don't know. August Linwall's wife is the Gabriel's, yes. They came from up, stay around Thibodeau or something like that. Do you remember where your, what was your very first job that you played? Do you remember that you ever got paid for? Was there even with any other band when you started out?
